name: author
title: Pack author
description: Writes a new specialist for this project. Reads the repository to learn what it is and what it already has, asks you only what the repository cannot answer, agrees the dimensions with you, and writes `.claude/skills/agency-<name>/`. What it leaves behind is uncommitted source in your working tree — git is the review, and the first real run is yours to start.

dimensions.title: What the specialist judges — and what it must not
The project facts the skill has to carry, because there is no config
Its questions — each one able to come back false
What counts as proof here, and what the gate would drop
Where a finding goes when it passes — or that it rests in the memory
What it may never do, and what stays outside `needs`
